_bridge: tests/security/scan-fidelity.test.mjs runs the REAL scanner over that HTML and deep-compares this file to its output; tests/security/board-fidelity.test.mjs additionally checks the served page carries the traits it claims. Edit one and the other goes red.
_keys: COMBOS ARE STAMPED FIRST. scan-page.js's combo loop runs before the input loop, so the react-select is f1 and the text inputs start at f2 — even though the sorted output puts the combo between the file inputs and the textarea. An earlier hand-written version of this file numbered fields in reading order and gave the combo f10, which is a shape the scanner cannot produce.
_sel: The combo and both radios have NO `sel`: stableSel() needs a unique id or a unique name/data-testid/data-qa/aria-label. The combo has none of those (its `data-aj-testid` is not `data-testid`) and the two radios SHARE a name, so no attribute selector is unique to either.
